[[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Papa/Legends|father]] was buried in a '''grave''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. It was a secret location in which Ziro hid the [[Hutt Council records/Legends|Hutt diary]], which contained critical information on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when Ziro came here to retrieve the diary, he was killed by [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] next to his father's remains.
